item.title: Review: Our favorite headphones and earbuds are cheaper than ever for Black Friday
item.description: If you haven’t already caved and bought a fresh set of wireless earbuds, over-ear headphones, or bone conduction headphones this year, Black Friday is rewarding you with a colossal amount of deals, including discounts on the best models available. Apple, Beats, Soundcore, Sony, Nothing, and other major brands are offering some of the best prices
item.dc:creator: AKTUAL MEDIA

item.title: Review: Can luxury save Macy's?
item.description: This week's celebration of Macy's 100th Thanksgiving parade finds the department store at a turning point. After years of losing sales, the retailer is reimagining itself — as a higher-end destination.
item.dc:creator: AKTUAL MEDIA

item.title: Review: Screen-free tweens try their hand at Dungeons & Dragons
item.description: Some parents, fed up with screens, have found an analog oasis in the role-playing game invented in the 1970s.
